The api_key value is the expression $credentials.SerpAPI.key; n8n 2.47.7 resolves it without an error and sends the request (canned check, R4e 2026-11-16), so the run goes on to Format SerpAPI Organic Results. responses.body:
Title: Heat pumps in cold climates: field data from Canada

URL Source: https://www.energy-research.example/heat-pumps-cold-climate

Markdown Content:
A two-winter field trial in Yukon and northern Quebec measured 42 cold-climate air-source heat pumps. Average seasonal COP was 2.1; at -25°C units still delivered a COP above 1.5. Below -30°C, 9 of 42 homes switched to backup resistance heat for a total of 61 hours.

Installers sized units to 100% of the design heat load. Homes with poor air sealing saw 30% higher electricity use.

Title: Do heat pumps work in freezing weather?

URL Source: https://www.home-energy.example/blog/heat-pumps-freezing

Markdown Content:
Yes, if you buy a cold-climate model and size it correctly. Look for the NEEP cold-climate listing and a rated capacity at 5°F (-15°C). Keep backup heat for the coldest days, and defrost cycles are normal.

3150122.title: Air source heat pump
3150122.extract: An air source heat pump (ASHP) is a heat pump that can absorb heat from air outside a building and release it inside. Cold climate models use variable-speed compressors and vapour injection to keep heating capacity at low outdoor temperatures.

branches: SerpAPI loop over the query chunks → Format SerpAPI Organic Results → Jina loop → per page: context agent → report agent → reply
expect.offline: Search queries, extracted contexts and the report are model-driven (n8n's replies are recorded); the only effect is the chat reply. n8n 2.47.7 resolves the template's $credentials expression in the api_key parameter without an error and sends Perform SerpAPI Search Request, so its baseline runs past it: normal and hostile succeed, empty stops at Format SerpAPI Organic Results and malformed at the Jina requests, as their branches say (canned check, R4e 2026-11-16). Both memory buffers share the custom session key my_test_session
